content: {"episode_id":"ep-05096","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-50 medical necessity denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229). The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias."}
